text: Paclitaxel binds directly to the $\beta$-tubulin subunit (encoded by *TUBB*) of microtubules, stabilizing them against depolymerization. This interaction prevents the normal reorganization of the microtubule network required for mitosis, leading to cell cycle arrest at the G2/M phase and subsequent apoptosis in ovarian cancer cells.
